verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing page explicitly lists "Schedule recurring tasks" alongside creating campaigns and flows. Its docs describe building automations and event-triggered flows that run automatically, and a community user describes setting up a re-engagement email with no extra work. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how recurring schedules are configured (cadence, time-based triggers), evidence that scheduling is exposed via the API or MCP server for agent-driven setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of recurring scheduling.
